 \<open>Based on wpc, corresKc examines the split rule for top-level case statements on the left
  and right hand sides, propagating backwards the stateless and left/right preconditions.\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  wpc2_helper :: "(('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<times> 'b set)
                 \<Rightarrow> (('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<times> 'b set) \<Rightarrow> (('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<times> 'b set)
                 \<Rightarrow> (('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<times> 'b set) \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool" where
 "wpc2_helper \<equiv> \<lambda>(P, P') (Q, Q') (PP, PP') (QQ,QQ') R.
    ((\<forall>s. P s \<longrightarrow> Q s) \<and> P' \<subseteq> Q') \<longrightarrow> ((\<forall>s. PP s \<longrightarrow> QQ s) \<and> PP' \<subseteq> QQ') \<longrightarrow> R"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "wpc2_protect B Q \<equiv> (Q :: bool)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma wpc2_helperI:
  "wpc2_helper (P, P') (P, P') (PP, PP') (PP, PP') Q \<Longrightarrow> Q"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. wpc2_helper (P, P') (P, P') (PP, PP') (PP, PP') Q \<Longrightarrow> Q<\STATESEP>by (simp add: wpc2_helper_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma wpc2_conj_process:
  "\<lbrakk> wpc2_helper (P, P') (A, A') (PP, PP') (AA, AA') C; wpc2_helper (P, P') (B, B') (PP, PP') (BB, BB') D \<rbrakk>
       \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (\<lambda>s. A s \<and> B s, A' \<inter> B') (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. AA s \<and> BB s, AA' \<inter> BB') (C \<and> D)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>wpc2_helper (P, P') (A, A') (PP, PP') (AA, AA') C; wpc2_helper (P, P') (B, B') (PP, PP') (BB, BB') D\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (\<lambda>s. A s \<and> B s, A' \<inter> B') (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. AA s \<and> BB s, AA' \<inter> BB') (C \<and> D)<\STATESEP>by (clarsimp simp add: wpc2_helper_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma wpc2_all_process:
  "\<lbrakk> \<And>x. wpc2_helper (P, P') (Q x, Q' x) (PP, PP') (QQ x, QQ' x) (R x) \<rbrakk>
       \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (\<lambda>s. \<forall>x. Q x s, {s. \<forall>x. s \<in> Q' x}) (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. \<forall>x. QQ x s, {s. \<forall>x. s \<in> QQ' x}) (\<forall>x. R x)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):

Q x s, {s. \<forall>x. s \<in> Q' x}) (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. \<forall>x. QQ x s, {s. \<forall>x. s \<in> QQ' x}) (\<forall>x. R x)<\STATESEP>by (clarsimp simp: wpc2_helper_def subset_iff)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma wpc2_imp_process:
  "\<lbrakk> wpc2_protect B Q \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (R, R') (PP, PP') (RR, RR') S \<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (\<lambda>s. Q \<longrightarrow> R s, {s. Q \<longrightarrow> s \<in> R'}) (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. Q \<longrightarrow> RR s, {s. Q \<longrightarrow> s \<in> RR'}) (Q \<longrightarrow> S)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (wpc2_protect B Q \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (R, R') (PP, PP') (RR, RR') S) \<Longrightarrow> wpc2_helper (P, P') (\<lambda>s. Q \<longrightarrow> R s, {s. Q \<longrightarrow> s \<in> R'}) (PP, PP') (\<lambda>s. Q \<longrightarrow> RR s, {s. Q \<longrightarrow> s \<in> RR'}) (Q \<longrightarrow> S)<\STATESEP>by (clarsimp simp add: wpc2_helper_def subset_iff wpc2_protect_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context

  \<open>This method wraps up wp and wpc to ensure that they don't accidentally generate schematic
   assumptions when handling hoare triples that emerge from corres proofs.
   This is partially due to wp not being smart enough to avoid applying certain wp_comb rules
   when the precondition is schematic, and arises when the schematic precondition doesn't have
   access to some meta-variables in the postcondition.

   To solve this, instead of meta-implication in the wp_comb rules we use corres_inst_eq, which
   can only be solved by reflexivity. In most cases these comb rules are either never applied or
   solved trivially. If users manually apply corres_rv rules to create postconditions with
   inaccessible meta-variables (@{method corresK_rv} will never do this), then these rules will
   be used. Since @{method corresK_inst} has access to the protected return-value relation, it has a chance
   to unify the generated precondition with the original schematic one.\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>named_theorems corresKwp_wp_comb and corresKwp_wp_comb_del<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma corres_inst_eq_imp:
  "corres_inst_eq A B \<Longrightarrow> A \<longrightarrow> B"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. corres_inst_eq A B \<Longrightarrow> A \<longrightarrow> B<\STATESEP>by (simp add: corres_inst_eq_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas corres_hoare_pre = hoare_pre[# \<open>-\<close> \<open>atomize (full), rule allI, rule corres_inst_eq_imp\<close>]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>method corresKwp uses wp =
  (determ \<open>
     (fails \<open>schematic_hoare_pre\<close>, (wp add: wp | wpc))
   | (schematic_hoare_pre,
        (use corresKwp_wp_comb [wp_comb]
             corresKwp_wp_comb_del[wp_comb del]
             hoare_pre[wp_pre del]
             corres_hoare_pre[wp_pre]
        in
      \<open>use in \<open>wp add: wp | wpc\<close>\<close>))\<close>)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas [corresKwp_wp_comb_del] =
  hoare_weaken_pre
  hoare_weaken_preE
  hoare_weaken_preE_R<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma corres_inst_conj_lift[corresKwp_wp_comb]:

  "corres_underlying sr nf nf' r (P x) (P' x) (f x) (f' x) \<Longrightarrow> x = x' \<Longrightarrow>
   corres_underlying sr nf nf' r (P x) (P' x') (f x) (f' x')"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

  (match premises in
    H[thin]:"corres_underlying _ _ _ _ (P x) (P' x) (f x) (f' x)" (cut 5) for P P' f f' x \<Rightarrow>
      \<open>match (f) in "\<lambda>_. g" for g \<Rightarrow> \<open>fail\<close> \<bar> _ \<Rightarrow>
        \<open>match (f') in "\<lambda>_. g'" for g' \<Rightarrow> \<open>fail\<close> \<bar> _ \<Rightarrow>
          \<open>cut_tac lift_args_corres[where f=f and f'=f' and P=P and P'=P', OF H]\<close>\<close>\<close>)+<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas corres_rv_def_I_know_what_I'm_doing = corres_rv_def<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas corres_rvE_R_def_I_know_what_I'm_doing = corres_rvE_R_def<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>hide_fact corres_rv_def<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>hide_fact corres_rvE_R_def<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
